clade4.evidence: FNS isolates were characterized by ERG11 Y132F ± S154F, a recurrent UPC2 Q289L substitution, up-regulation of efflux pump genes (CDR1, CDR2, and MDR1), and predominance of DST538/DST544 lineages.
clade4.note: The authors associate the DST544/DST538 lineages (CC10) with fluconazole resistance but do not call them 'clade 4' nor link them to the Chinese CC2/DST225 clone or the orchard genotype; they warn that MLST does not establish clonality. No susceptible isolates were typed for comparison.

dynamics.description: C. tropicalis accounted for 17.3%–22.7% of all clinical Candida isolates per year, with no significant trend (OR per year 1.02, 95% CI 0.98–1.07; P=0.35).

Annual fluconazole non-susceptibility among sterile-site C. tropicalis ranged from 3.8% to 12.5% with no linear increase (OR per year 1.12, 95% CI 0.90–1.41; P=0.31); overall 8.2%. Yearly values only in Figure 1.
